candidate.definition_en: Used to say that it does not matter which of a set is chosen.
candidate.explanation_ar: أي واحد تختاره من المجموعة، مش فارقة انهي واحد.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that it does not matter which person or thing from a set is chosen.
senses.definition_ar: أيّ من مجموعة معينة، بغض النظر عن الاختيار.

examples: Take whichever book you want to read.
Whichever way you go, it will take an hour.
The prize will be awarded to whichever contestant scores highest.
